title: ShinyHunters Claims FBI Data Breach via Oracle Zero-Day, Defaces Careers Site
detail: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims to have stolen data on all FBI employees and applicants — including home addresses and family details — exploiting an Oracle zero-day vulnerability, and defaced the FBI careers website. The claim is unverified; the sole source is a tier-3 Telegram channel. No official FBI or government confirmation has been issued.
